description: Qualitative synthesis of a company's latest annual and quarterly reports, condensed from the filings themselves rather than from news: business description, risk factors with changes since the prior filing flagged, annual MD&A, the current quarter, legal proceedings and subsequent events. Called without `section` it returns an INDEX: every section with its size, first sentence and subsection headings, because the full document is large. Then pass `section` as a heading or subsection heading from the index, or as a topic (business, risk factors, md&a, current quarter, subsequent events, legal), which finds the matching sections whatever this company calls them ('legal' also pulls legal items from the 8-K digest), or 'all' for everything. Pass `record` for the narrative as of an earlier record. To find a keyword anywhere, use search_text.

record.description: An earlier published record, by tag ('FY27Q1') or by the period its filing reports ('Q1 FY2027'). Omit for the latest. list_periods lists every record.

section.description: A heading or subsection heading (case-insensitive; a unique prefix is enough), a topic (business, risk factors, md&a, current quarter, subsequent events, legal), or 'all'. Omit for the index.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, case-insensitive. Examples: NVDA, brk-b, BRK.B.

name: get_narrative
title: 10-K and 10-Q narrative
